''See also: [[Seisha Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Wei Shi Seisha is a respected member of the [[Wei clan]] and the mother of [[Lindon]]. She serves a vital role within her family, performing functions that earn her widespread esteem among various clans. As an individual involved in the clan's scholarly and technical pursuits, she is often seen taking meticulous notes on scrolls or notebooks, utilizing tools such as brushes, ink, and chalk. She also employs a [[drudge]]—a floating [[construct]] resembling a segmented brown fish made of [[dead matter]]—to assist her in various tasks, including inspecting [[madra]] and tracking [[Remnants]]. Seisha has demonstrated expertise in studying the [[Path of the White Fox]] and has worked on designing displays for clan festivals. Throughout her life, she has been a protective figure for her son and has faced significant hardships, including being held in the [[Serpent's Grave]] within the [[Blackflame Empire]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Unsouled}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Wei Shi Seisha is the mother of [[Lindon]] and possesses long brown hair.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c1">''Unsouled'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c2">''Unsouled'', chapter 2</ref> She utilizes a [[drudge]] capable of absorbing items such as chalk while using a brush and ink jar to take notes on a scroll.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c3">''Unsouled'', chapter 3</ref> Distinguished by brown eyes that are lighter than those of anyone else in the clan, she manages the arena staff during its construction.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c8">''Unsouled'', chapter 8</ref> While accompanied by a guard, she advises [[Lindon]] to remain observant and continue learning.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c9">''Unsouled'', chapter 9</ref> Having reached the [[Iron stage]] in her twenty-second year, she finds herself near the [[Grand Patriarch of the Li clan]] as he settles on the forest floor, causing her to break into a cold sweat.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c9" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Wei Shi Seisha, I suggest you take your son to the next testing. Perhaps the heavens will choose to have mercy on him then.” Seisha, Lindon’s mother, draws him to her waist protectively.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Seisha pushed him aside, drudge still floating over her shoulder. “Keep your eyes open. Learn what you can. However it turns out today, it's not the end of your path.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c9" />}}
